intro: Answer the questions below in order. Each branch points you to the most relevant programs. You can appear in more than one branch.

questions.question: Are you a student, researcher, or aspiring founder without a registered company yet?

branches.label: No
branches.note: You have (or are forming) a registered company. Continue below.

branches.label: Idea / PoC stage: grants to start
Prototype and beyond: ready to build or sell

questions.question: What kind of support do you need most right now?

branches.label: Tax savings for you or your investors

questions.question: Are you doing genuine technical R&D — a new or meaningfully improved product, process, or software?

branches.label: No
branches.note: Most R&D-specific programs won't apply, but general small-business financing and tax provisions still might.

questions.question: Do you or your business fall into one of these categories: woman-owned, minority-owned, veteran-owned, or located in a HUBZone?
